envelope.reason: adoption: a hand-made link already leading to this harness's launcher, recorded with the host's consent at install, is the install's to remove; the glosses said the opposite of the ruling

payload.gloss: running a harness's main session as a projected persona, with the persona's identity as its system prompt and its composed skills loaded before the first turn, exactly as a dispatched holder of the same position receives them. omp reaches it through the generated launcher; Claude Code through claude --agent, which applies the identity but preloads skills only for subagents, so the projection must carry the skills into the main session itself. Install makes each installed persona launchable by its name: it places a command named after the persona in the host's user bin directory on PATH (~/.local/bin), linked to the harness's launcher (omp: the generated omp-agent, which resolves the persona from its own name), never overwriting a file there that it did not place, and reports what it placed and when that directory is not on PATH; uninstall removes only what it placed; a command the host linked by hand to this harness's launcher is adopted with the host's consent at install (recorded, never re-created) and from then on counts as placed.
